newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 14.

text.p: -- Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said it agreed to sell its polyester polymer, titanium dioxide and polyester film business to DuPont Co for $3 billion. DuPont's stock closed on Friday at 63-1/4, while ICI's was trading at 873 pence in London.

-- Campbell Soup Co is considering shedding "nonstrategic" businesses with $1.4 billion in sales, in a move to focus on volume growth in its core soup, sauces, biscuits and food service lines, the Wall Street Journal reported. Campbell stock closed at 48-7/8.

-- Waste Management Inc is expected to announce it has chosen Ronald LeMay as its new chairman and chief executive, the Wall Street Journal reported. LeMay is president and chief operating officer of Sprint Corp. Waste Management stock closed at 33 on Friday.

-- Boeing Co said it made progress but no deal in talks at the weekend with the European Comission on its planned $14 billion merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp. Boeing's stock closed at 56-7/16 while McDonnell's stock finished at 49-15/16.
